 PEDESTRIAN STRUCK AND KILLED IN CARNESVILLE
 November 20, 2026 MJ Kneiser 
 A New Jersey man has died after being hit while crossing a road in Carnesville.
 According to Georgia State Patrol Post 52 Trooper Jesse Lamb, it happened about 6:23 Thursday evening on Highway 106 in Carnesville in front of the Pilot Truck Stop.
 The man, identified as 55-year-old Hector Luis Herrara of Camden, NJ, was attempting to cross Highway 106 when he was struck by a black 2023 Jeep Gladiator traveling south.
 Herrara was taken by ambulance to St. Mary’s Sacred Heart Hospital, where he died from his injuries.
 His next of kin have been notified.
